ItemID: 1; Title: 100 Nitrile Exam Gloves 3.5 Mil - Latex & Powder Free, Disposable Non-Sterile Protective Gloves By PlastCare; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Useful disposable gloves for messy adhesive and resin work; I would check chemical compatibility before using them with epoxy.
ItemID: 2; Title: Wintact Decibel Meter 30 to 130dBA, Digital Sound Noise Level Reader Tester Portable with Calibration for Classroom Home, School, Outdoor, Ambient; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I buy measuring tools, but I have no immediate project that needs sound-level measurements.
ItemID: 3; Title: Feggizuli 280PCS Crimp Connectors, 2.8mm 4.8mm 6.3mm Male and Female Spade Connector kit, 15 Types Crimp Terminals Electrical Connectors, Electrical Terminals Includes Spade Ring Fork Wire Connectors; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: A connector assortment fits my habit of stocking hardware for repairs and would be useful for wiring projects.
ItemID: 4; Title: Okebond Super Glue Clear Strong Repair (Blue OB-4700+1pcs); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Quick repairs need a different adhesive from my mounting tape and casting resin, so I would try this.
ItemID: 5; Title: Eventek Infrared Thermometer Gun, [3 in 1] -58°F~1112°F (-50°C~600°C) Digital Laser Temperature Gun for Cooking, Pizza Oven, Grill & Engine with Adjustable Emissivity, Meat Thermometer & Bag Included; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I recently interacted with a similar infrared thermometer and do not currently need another.
ItemID: 6; Title: BOCEUC Silicone Multimeter Test Leads Kit, Banana Plug, Alligator Clips, Tester Hook Tip Test Clip for for Fluke Multimeter Electronic Clamp Meter Accessories; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: These could help with electrical troubleshooting, but I would need to confirm compatibility with my equipment before choosing them.
ItemID: 7; Title: AUTOAlkins 8" Heavy Duty Suction Cup to Lift Large Glass, Tile, Marble, Industrial Vacuum Suction Lifter with Handle for Glass Lifting & Replacement, 240 lbs Load Capacity (2 Pack); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent projects do not suggest an immediate need to lift large glass panels or slabs.
ItemID: 8; Title: TPOIMNS PLA Filament 1.75mm, Navy Blue PLA 3D Printer Filament, 1kg Spool (2.2lbs), Dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.03mm, Used by Most FDM 3D Printer; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My tool purchases do not establish that I use a 3D printer, so I would skip this consumable.
ItemID: 9; Title: Luftzeuge Black PLA Filament 1.75mm with Good Adhesion - Fit Most FDM Printers - Dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.03 mm for High Precision - 1 KG Spool; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current printing project or established need for printer filament.
ItemID: 10; Title: AIRIC 3/8 inch Heat Shrink Tubing 3:1 Small Marine Grade Shrinking Cable Tube Dual Wall Adhesive Shrinkable Wire Wrap Tubes Roll, Fully Insulation (20 Feet Black Tubing, and 20 Feet Red Tubing); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Insulating repaired wiring would complement the connector kit, though this single tubing size limits its usefulness.
